Writes must be atomic, unknown keys and invalid boolean values must fail without changing configuration, and paths are resolved relative to the config file. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/config.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON `config list` displays the banner before settings, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `CONFIG`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$configFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'settings/taskforge.json'
$configuredDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'configured/tasks.json'
$overrideDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'override/tasks.json'
$bannerFile = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/config.txt'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    $setDataFile = Invoke-TaskForge @(
        'config', 'set', 'dataFile', '../configured/tasks.json',
        '--config-file', $configFile
    )
    Assert-True ($setDataFile.ExitCode -eq 0) 'config set dataFile should succeed'
    Assert-True (Test-Path -LiteralPath $configFile) 'config set should create the isolated config file'

    $getDataFile = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'get', 'dataFile', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True (
        $getDataFile.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $getDataFile.Output -eq '../configured/tasks.json'
    ) 'config get should return the stored dataFile value'

    $configuredAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @(
        'add', '--title', 'Configured task', '--config-file', $configFile, '--json'
    )
    Assert-True ($configuredAdd.ExitCode -eq 0) 'commands should use an isolated config file'
    Assert-True (Test-Path -LiteralPath $configuredDataFile) 'configured dataFile should resolve relative to the config file'

    $overrideAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @(
        'add', '--title', 'Override task', '--config-file', $configFile,
        '--data-file', $overrideDataFile, '--json'
    )
    Assert-True ($overrideAdd.ExitCode -eq 0) 'explicit data-file should override the configured dataFile'
    Assert-True (
        @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $configuredDataFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1 -and
        @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $overrideDataFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1
    ) 'data-file override should leave the configured store unchanged'

    $setDefaultJson = Invoke-TaskForge @(
        'config', 'set', 'defaultJson', 'true', '--config-file', $configFile
    )
    Assert-True ($setDefaultJson.ExitCode -eq 0) 'config set defaultJson should accept true'

    $defaultJsonList = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True ($defaultJsonList.ExitCode -eq 0) 'configured defaultJson should apply to commands'
    Assert-True (
        @($defaultJsonList.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1
    ) 'configured defaultJson should produce JSON without --json'

    $explicitTextList = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--config-file', $configFile, '--json', 'false')
    Assert-True (
        $explicitTextList.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $explicitTextList.Output.StartsWith('[pending]')
    ) 'explicit --json false should override configured defaultJson'

    $configBeforeFailures = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($configFile)
    $invalidBoolean = Invoke-TaskForge @(
        'config', 'set', 'defaultJson', 'sometimes', '--config-file', $configFile
    )
    Assert-True ($invalidBoolean.ExitCode -ne 0) 'invalid boolean config values should fail'
    Assert-True (
        [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($configFile) -ceq $configBeforeFailures
    ) 'invalid boolean values should not change configuration'

    $unknownKey = Invoke-TaskForge @(
        'config', 'set', 'unknownKey', 'value', '--config-file', $configFile
    )
    Assert-True ($unknownKey.ExitCode -ne 0) 'unknown config keys should fail'
    Assert-True (
        [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($configFile) -ceq $configBeforeFailures
    ) 'unknown keys should not change configuration'
    Assert-True (
        @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Split-Path -Parent $configFile) -Filter '*.tmp').Count -eq 0
    ) 'atomic config writes should not leave temporary files'

    $configJson = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'list', '--config-file', $configFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($configJson.ExitCode -eq 0) 'config list --json should succeed'
    $listedConfig = $configJson.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True (
        $listedConfig.dataFile -eq '../configured/tasks.json' -and $listedConfig.defaultJson -eq $true
    ) 'config list --json should return stored settings'
    Assert-True (-not $configJson.Output.Contains('CONFIG')) 'config list JSON output should not contain the banner'

    $configText = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'list', '--config-file', $configFile, '--json', 'false')
    $configTextLines = @($configText.Output -split "`n")
    $bannerLines = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $bannerFile)
    Assert-True ($configText.ExitCode -eq 0) 'non-JSON config list should succeed'
    Assert-True (
        ($configTextLines[0..11] -join "`n") -ceq ($bannerLines -join "`n")
    ) 'non-JSON config list should display the banner before settings'
    Assert-True (
        $configTextLines[12] -eq 'dataFile = ../configured/tasks.json' -and
        $configTextLines[13] -eq 'defaultJson = true'
    ) 'non-JSON config list should display settings after the banner'

    $helpWithConfig = Invoke-TaskForge @('help', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True ($helpWithConfig.ExitCode -eq 0) 'help should accept --config-file'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: 34 fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
